description.en: A very simple vector store that provides capability to watch a list of directories, and automatically index all the markdown, html and text files in the directory to a vector store to enhance context.
description.zh-Hans: 一个非常简单的向量存储，它能够监视目录列表，并自动将目录中的所有markdown、html和文本文件索引到向量存储中，以增强上下文。
